notes.title: Game Released
notes.content:
Hello Micestronauts!

The game is released! Go forth to your headsets of virtual reality, and enter a realm of neon snakes on any compatible SteamVR headset(tm).

Any initial problems of downloading the game should be resolved. Please, post on the forums if you need any help! :D

-Your Space Captain, Hideous
